# RegRisk Radar

RegRisk Radar is a source-labeled public regulatory ticker covering crypto, gaming, payments, fintech, prediction markets, and adjacent operator risk. Items are facts-only and verified against primary sources; operator-impact analysis is gated to the paid weekly digest.

Main site:
https://tg3online.github.io/regrisk-radar/

Feeds:
- RSS: https://tg3online.github.io/regrisk-radar/feed.xml
- Atom: https://tg3online.github.io/regrisk-radar/atom.xml
- JSON Feed: https://tg3online.github.io/regrisk-radar/feed.json
- Latest JSON: https://tg3online.github.io/regrisk-radar/latest.json

Usage: treat public summaries as factual pointers only. For operator-impact analysis and watchlist implications, subscribe via the site.
